paras: Taylor's blind skink (Dibamus taylori), also known commonly as the Lesser Sunda blind lizard, is a species of legless lizard in the family Dibamidae. The species is endemic to the Lesser Sunda Islands.
The specific name, taylori, is in honor of American herpetologist Edward Harrison Taylor.
